title: Monoidal ordinary identity and composition restriction comparisons
statement: For arbitrary normalized ordinary tensor transports along ring-sheaf isomorphisms, the canonical identity and composition inverse-restriction comparisons are monoidal. Their unit equations express composition of the inverse ring maps; their tensor equations preserve each pure tensor. Dependencies: [lem-pur-u2-restriction-comparisons], [lem-sfb-scalar-ordinary-tensor-comparison], [lem-sfb-ring-isomorphism-tensor-transport].

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryComp_monoidal {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{r}}
    (a : R ≅ S) (b : S ≅ T)
    (oa : RingIsoTensorTransport a.symm) (ob : RingIsoTensorTransport b.symm)
    (oc : RingIsoTensorTransport (a ≪≫ b).symm) :
    let : (scalarRestriction a.inv).Braided := oa.monoidal
    let : (scalarRestriction b.inv).Braided := ob.monoidal
    let : (scalarRestriction (a ≪≫ b).inv).Braided := oc.monoidal
    NatTrans.IsMonoidal (ordinaryComp a b).hom
